name: How does luxury sales representation differ from standard real estate services?

mainEntity.name: How does luxury sales representation differ from standard real estate services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury sales representation differs from standard services through its highly specialized approach to marketing, client discretion, and transaction complexity. It involves bespoke marketing campaigns aimed at an exclusive buyer pool, often including international outreach, and a deeper understanding of high-net-worth client needs. While standard services focus on broader market appeal, luxury representation tailors every aspect to a property's unique prestige and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury sales representation offers specialized marketing, client discretion, and expertise in complex transactions, unlike standard real estate services that focus on broader market appeal.
